messages:
Marta: Quick sync — launching the SI onboarding pilot that bundles marketplace listing + hardware starter kit + a lightweight certification. Goal: 2 SIs in the pilot, public marketplace listing, and a 1-week instructor-led cert by end of Q3. Who can own playbook, cert rubric, and hw logistics?
Raj: I can take the playbook + deployment templates. Will pull in sample infra-as-code and a reference app.
Oliver: I'll own HW kit logistics. Need lead time for procurement and region-specific shipping rules. Estimate 6 weeks for EU/US stock.
Taylor: I'll drive GTM and joint announcement plan. Need finalized logos, joint customer quotes, and a launch window.
Sam: I'll draft the certification rubric — proposed tiers: "Verified Integrator" (config + deploy), "Certified Operator" (support + runbooks). Short practical lab + checklist = pass/fail.
Marta: Awesome. We also need a minimal marketplace listing template that SIs can reuse. Raj, can you add a schema example?
Raj: Yep. Pushing a quick manifest snippet below for the listing metadata we should standardize:
```yaml
name: redwood-si-integration
version: 0.1.0
authors:
  - name: "SI Partner"
  - name: "Redwood Inference"
regions: [us-west1, europe-west1]
support_contact: team@si.example.com
components:
  - type: model-endpoint
  - type: deployment-template
  - type: hw-integration-guide
```
Raj: Also adding fields for SLA level, tested model set, and quantization profiles.
Marta: For the cert labs — keep them ~90 minutes, hands-on. Sam, can the rubric map to the manifest fields so we can auto-validate basic items? e.g., check `regions` present, `components` includes `deployment-template`.
Sam: Yes — I'll create an automated checklist script that verifies manifest keys and runs a smoke deploy against a sandbox endpoint. Pass criteria + manual review.
Oliver: HW note: kit will include 1x edge GPU unit, 1x fob with onboarding script, and networking checklist. Packaging needs customs docs for EU. I can share the packing spec by EOD.
Taylor: For the announcement cadence: internal preview -> partner demo day -> marketplace publish -> joint blog. Can we target partner demo day in 6 weeks?
Marta: Timeline seems tight with HW lead time. Option: soft-launch listing (no kit shipping) for demo day, then full kit availability 6 weeks later. Thoughts?
Raj: That works. Soft-listing should include a demo image and a deployable template that uses Redwood's hosted sandbox.
Sam: For the certification cohorts, propose 2 pilot cohorts of 6 engineers each. We should do one cohort focused on deployment and one on ops/sre.
Marta: Agree. Who owns signups and scheduling? Taylor?
Taylor: Yep, I'll handle signups and calendar invites. Need names/emails by next Tuesday.
marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Marketplace listing checklist due" in 3 days.
Marta: Action items recap: Raj -> playbook + manifest template by Fri; Sam -> cert rubric + auto-checker prototype by next Wed; Oliver -> HW kit spec + customs checklist by EOD; Taylor -> demo day invite + landing page draft by next Tue. I'll consolidate into a single playbook doc and ping legal for partner MSA bullets. :thumbsup:
Raj: Adding PR template for the marketplace listing so ops can preview changes. Will post a link in the playbook.
Oliver: One more: we need a returns and RMA flow for kits — I'll put a draft process in the pack spec.
Marta: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker, drop it here and flag @marta. Thanks all!
